The purpose of the "risk-based approach" in assessing animal welfare at zoos is to identify and prioritize potential welfare risks associated with the housing, care, and management of animals in captivity. By focusing on the most critical welfare concerns, zoos can target their efforts and resources more effectively to address the most pressing issues and improve the overall welfare of the animals in their care. This approach also helps to ensure that the most vulnerable animals receive the most attention and support.
